text_block_list.text: Narita Taishin isn't here today either.

I hear that she hasn't been seen around
the
academy for some time.

While I'm worried about her, she's still
the only
one who can decide whether
she'll continue to
race or not.
So...

I always have and always will believe in
her.
choice_data_list: (I'll be waiting for you right here.)
(I'll be waiting for you right here.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (What should I do now?)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh... Taishiiiin! You have a visitor!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: TAISHIN!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket... What's gotten into—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come with me! Now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The heck? You want me to watch a
basketball
game?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I suuure do!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
There's a player I've been following
lately, and she's in the starting five in
today's game! It's been
ages since she
started!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I know you like sports, but did
you have
to drag me into this?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I get really energized when I watch
sports. Like
all, "Yaaah!" Fired up,
y'know what I mean?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, well...
I figured if you watched too...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You could feel like me and get all...
YAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Okay, I get you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll watch the game, so stop yelling
already.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yay, Taishin! Hehe! I'll turn on the TV!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I'm pretty sure I've seen that player
with
the red
hair before.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Count that basket! With her eleventh 
three-pointer, she nails the
buzzer-beater and
clinches the game for
her team!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! That was so, so, so amazing! Woooow!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Taishin?! The girl with
the red
hair was incredible, right?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
She didn't seem to be doing well last
year, but
then she suddenly got super
good this spring!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (This spring?)

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on! No one's rooting for
you! No
one thinks you can win!

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that make you want to give up?
Most
people would...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's the postgame interview—they're
gonna
talk to her!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: You were amazing on the court!

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm glad my training paid off.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
We heard that you'd been struggling for
some
time—did something snap you out
of it?

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm a basketball player, but I
wasn't blessed
with height, as you can
see.

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I was getting left behind because of my
stature,
and I was in a pretty bad place
this spring.

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to give it all up since I figured
no one
expected anything of me, but...

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Someone gave me the courage not to
give up. Her way of thinking's a bit odd,
but she's not a
quitter. She's stronger
than anyone I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (It's her...)

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
We don't play the same sport, but she's
the
athlete I admire the most.

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to show the world
who I
really am—no matter how weak or
pathetic they
might see me!

text_block_list.name: Red-haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I want to be proud to show everyone the
real me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaah! That's sooo touching!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What is that? Some passive-aggressive
jab at me? "Ooh, look at her! She's so
small, but she's trying!
What an
inspiration!" Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're wrong!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You refuse to lose even when the odds
are
against you, and you never give up
no matter how
tough things are!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Your determination is what makes you so
cool!
You really inspire and encourage
me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
At least, that's what I've always thought
about
you, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're not my rival because you're small!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're my rival because you're you!

I can't even count the number of times
I've
flip-flopped between leaving or
waiting a little
longer for Narita Taishin.

But just as the sun begins to set... she
appears.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Have you been here this whole time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You mean, like, every day?
choice_data_list: ...Yeah.
...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Why do you have so much faith in me?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You've been like that ever since you
scouted me,
even though I don't have
the slightest bit of faith
in myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I just don't know what to do anymore. I...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: Do you want to give up already?
Want to give up already?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Not running is a perfectly valid c...
Not running is a perfectly valid c...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No! I don't want to give up! As if I'd do
that right
now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But I don't know what to do! I'm not
proud of who
I am! I just see someone
revoltingly pathetic!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to believe that I'm
fine the
way I am—that I can continue to
race like this?
There's no way!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: Then I'll believe enough for the b...
Then I'll believe in you enough fo...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: A-all of them?
choice_data_list: Throw all your worries at me!
Throw all your worries at me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what the heck? What are you
even
saying right now...
choice_data_list: I'll keep telling you "it's okay" ...
I'll keep saying 'It's okay' until...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look, I've come this far, but my mindset
hasn't
changed at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why would you double your faith to
cover for
me? What if you're stuck with
that crap forever?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What if it takes your entire lifetime,
stupid?!
choice_data_list: Take as long as it takes!
Take as long as you need!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: Even for the rest of my life!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you'd agree to believe in
me for
your entire life.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You really are an idiot.

Narita Taishin says that she'll try
running
a little
more.

Her decision made, we begin to talk
about our
next race.

There's one I want to suggest that might
help her
gain a more positive outlook on
things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The Nikkei Sho?

The Satsuki Sho is where Narita Taishin
left her
mark on the world—where
everyone finally
recognized her abilities.
choice_data_list: It's held at Nakayama Racecourse, ...
It's held at Nakayama Racecourse, ...

text_block_list.text:
I put forward the idea of racing again at
the place
she had her major turning
point.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah.
choice_data_list: Are you sure?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll go with you again... and try.
